# Lux Education Partners (LEP)

Luxembourg-based education services operated by Silver Bay Mountain Group S.à r.l. (RCS B293621).
Founder and author: James Liu, known in Chinese as 修印先生.

Chinese, English and French guides serve families considering education in Luxembourg, Switzerland and the Netherlands. The guides combine school information, first-hand visits and the author's professional judgments. Individual cases are not general guarantees.

## Contact
Email: contact@luxedupartners.lu

English and French readers: WhatsApp https://wa.me/352661221289
